series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: R-squared gate on dual open/close regression forecasts
mechanism: Solve β via LU (RMatrixSolve) on m_size lagged DATA_TREND (high-MA minus low-MA change) or DATA_RANGE ((LowΔ)-(HighΔ)) series; forecast y = intercept + Σβx + error (last residual or SE). Compute R² = 1 − SS_res/SS_tot vs MA-based totals; Long/ShortCondition return 0 unless R² ≥ m_open_determination (or close params when a position is open). Normalized signal = round(100·y / max(|y|, recent |Data|)). Separate open vs close collinearity/error/data enums.
data_needed: Symbol OHLC; optional dual MA of highs/lows; ATR for pending offset; m_size≥3; open/close determination, collinearity, error, data enums
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4; optimize 2018-01-01 to 2021-01-01 V-shaped window; ATR pending + ATR trail
why_new_for_mis: Treats coefficient of determination as an explicit ‘regression-is-dependable’ regime sensor so MIS only trusts autoregressive price/range forecasts when local explanatory power clears a threshold—and switches open vs close parameter sets by position state.
quote: If the coefficient of determination as computed by the 'CheckDetermination' function… is less than this parameter then the long or short conditions will return zero.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: Spearman-inverse collinearity weight on forecast or error
mechanism: Take two length-m_size windows of independent-variable Data; _c = 1/(2+min(−1, Spearman(a1,a2))); multiply _c onto predicted y, onto error ε, onto both, or neither (CHECK_Y/E/ALL/NONE). Softens inflated forecasts when recent regressors are redundant.
data_needed: Two consecutive Data windows of length m_size; MathCorrelationSpearman
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a continuous multicollinearity/redundancy sensor on feature windows that can down-weight forecasts when inputs become too similar—useful for any multi-lag price sensor stack.
quote: we will take the inverse of the spearman correlation between two recent data sets of independent variables and normalise it

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: Recency-and-magnitude weighted up vs down bar Shannon entropy
mechanism: Over recent bars, accumulate separate long_entropy and short_entropy: for each bar with closeΔ>0 or <0, add −(1/SIGNALS[i])·((SIGNALS[i]−s)/SIGNALS[i])·(|Δ|/range)·log2(1/SIGNALS[i]). Signal = short_entropy − long_entropy: higher entropy on down bars means less information about shorts → treat as buy (and vice versa). Normalize by max entropy log2(n) for 0–1 scoring; feed into decision-forest + fuzzy layer trained only on optimization. Also scales lots by |condition|.
data_needed: Recent close changes and bar ranges; lookback __SIGNALS weights; optional DF training samples on open/close thresholds
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: 4-hour open-price optimization (symbol not uniquely fixed in text); Shannon money class scales by absolute condition
why_new_for_mis: Splits information entropy by signed bars with recency×magnitude weights—MIS can stream an up-vs-down entropy imbalance as a directional uncertainty / regime-change precursor rather than a single scalar entropy.
quote: Supposing we explored the idea of the entropy of falling bars being greater than that of rising bars within a fixed set of recent bars as implying a buy signal and vice versa?

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: Five-state close-change Markov CPD transition matrix
mechanism: Discrete-time Markov via alglib CMarkovCPD: states = last __S_STATES (5) successive close changes, each normalized by GetState to <1 (down), 1 (flat), >1 (up) using |Δ_new|/(|Δ_new|+|Δ_old|). Add m_signal_tracks tracks, Tikhonov-regularize, MCPDSolve → transition matrix _p used to forecast next state probabilities for Long/ShortCondition. Chart TF defines the discrete time unit.
data_needed: Close series on chosen TF; m_signal_tracks; Tikhonov regularizer scaled to track magnitude
why_new_for_mis: A compact signed-return state machine whose transition matrix is itself a live regime sensor—MIS can track P(up|history) and state occupancy without assuming stationarity of raw prices.
quote: These discrete-time chain will have 5 states that are simply the last 5 changes in close price. So the timeframe on which the expert is tested or run will define the discrete time unit.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: FFT epicycle amplitude as volatility forecast for ATR trail
mechanism: Take 6 successive close changes, FFTR1D with 5 epicycles (CFastFourierTransform); reconstruct matrix of complex coefficients. Select component by fixed Index, by max |amplitude|, or by min |amplitude|; map forecast to _type∈[0,1] and scale stop distance: atr = max(2·spread, high−low)·_type; SL = extreme ± step·atr. Same RSI entries, exits driven by FT trail.
data_needed: Close (or high−low range) buffer; epicycle count; optional index or max/min amplitude rule
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY H4, 2022-01-01 to 2023-01-01; RSI signal + fixed-margin MM; no fixed TP/SL
why_new_for_mis: Uses a chosen Fourier component of recent returns as a continuous volatility/range forecast sensor to modulate stop distance—MIS can stream dominant-frequency amplitude as a short-horizon vol regime channel.
quote: we will look at decomposing a time series of range pricing (highs minus lows). We will then examine these constituent frequencies and see if any particular one… has a useful correlation with the next changes in the price ranges.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: Newton polynomial range forecast for trail and lot shrink
mechanism: Divided-difference Newton Set/Get on vectors X=bar index, Y=high−low (trail) or Δ(high−low) (money). Extrapolate at XX=−1 for next range/Δrange. Trail: delta = m_stop_level·ŷ + stops-level points. Money: if ŷ>0 shrink lot by ŷ/(current_range + decrease_factor·point + ŷ)—never size up on forecasted calmer ranges. Signal path instead interpolates closes and maps projected Δclose into 0–100 vs high−low window.
data_needed: OHLC for length m_length; unique X indices; m_stop_level / m_decrease_factor
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY H1 year 2023; AO signal for trail/money controls; signal-only Newton on closes
why_new_for_mis: Lightweight non-storage interpolant that turns bar-range path into a one-step volatility forecast usable both as trailing width and as a one-sided size damper—MIS can reuse the same ŷ as a short-horizon range sensor.
quote: if we are forecasting increasing price bar range, then we’d proportionately decrease our position size however if it is not increasing then we do nothing.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: CNN triple feature-map: bull / bear / whipsaw medians
mechanism: Input matrix: close−MA gaps across many MA periods. Single-layer CNN: Pad (zero/edge/reflect) → Convolve kernels → LeakyReLU → Pool (max/avg). Train per bar to three target matrices: multi-horizon/weighted high changes (bullishness), low changes (bearishness), close-magnitude changes (whipsaw). Inference: score = (median(out0)₊ − |median(out1)₋|) / (|long|+|short|+|neutral|); >0.5→long else short.
data_needed: Grid of MA handles; H/L/C rates over kernel window; learning rate, epochs, train_set, input_size
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY daily 2023; 5×5 inputs, three 3×3 kernels, padded to 3×3 outputs
why_new_for_mis: Produces three parallel neural feature maps whose medians separately sense bullish impulse, bearish impulse, and flat/whipsaw—MIS can treat the triple as a directional-plus-chop regime vector rather than a single logit.
quote: large values in highs mean bullishness… large values in lows mean bearishness… and small magnitude in close imply a whipsaw market

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: Matérn vs linear GP kernel switch for trend/vol roughness
mechanism: Gaussian Process regression with selectable KERNEL_LINEAR (Rows[i]·Cols[ii]+c) or KERNEL_MATERN ν=3/2: (1+√3|x−x′|/ℓ)·exp(−√3|x−x′|/ℓ). Signal path forecasts close-change path; Long/Short from sign of last vs first forecast, scaled 0–100 by path range. Money path feeds ATR changes into same GP and cuts lots only if forecast ATR path is rising and consecutive losses accrued. Article notes ν=½ jagged/vol, ν→∞ RBF-smooth, and GP confidence intervals for flat/whipsaw filtering.
data_needed: Past/next time vectors and observed series (closeΔ or ATRΔ); m_constant / length-scale m_next; kernel enum
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPJPY daily 2023 optimizations for both kernels; ATR-based money class variant
why_new_for_mis: Kernel choice (linear vs Matérn smoothness) is itself a regime prior—MIS can run both, compare predictive roughness/uncertainty, and use rising-ATR GP path as a volatility-aware size gate.
quote: The parameter ν controls the smoothness, so lower ν captures rough volatility, while higher ν smoothens trends.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: ATR expansion, contraction, and MA±2·ATR channel patterns
mechanism: Pattern0: three rising ATR bars + three rising/falling closes → vol-breakout continuation. Pattern1: ATR ≥ threshold·Point with directional closes → breakout confirmation. Pattern2: ATR ≥ 2×threshold with opposite closes → exhaustion/exit-as-entry. Pattern3: three falling ATR after a prior directional run → contraction reversal. Pattern4: Close > MA+2·ATR (buy) or < MA−2·ATR (sell) as ATR bands. Also trailing/money from price|MA|SAR ± k·ATR stop gaps sized to max risk % of free margin.
data_needed: iATR; optional MA/SAR; m_threshold_points; pattern bit-mask; risk percent
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD / EURCHF H1 year 2022 pattern tests; ADX wrap-up on same wizard stack
why_new_for_mis: Codifies ATR path shape (expand / contract / channel pierce) as discrete volatility-regime events MIS can emit alongside a continuous ATR z-score—plus stop-gap→lot as a liquidity-of-risk sensor.
quote: When the current ATR value rises significantly above its recent average, it may indicate a volatility breakout.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: ADX main-buffer collapse from strong trend as reversal sensor
mechanism: Pattern6: Base(X+3)≥50 and Base(X)≤40 plus close vs close[m_ma_period] direction → treat ADX collapse after a strong trend as reversal (buy after strong downtrend collapse, sell after strong uptrend collapse). Pattern7: ADX cross up through 25 with Bollinger upper/lower pierce. Pattern8: ADX cross 25 with RSI 50 cross for trend initiation.
data_needed: ADX main (+ optional DI); Bollinger bands; RSI; MA period for prior trend direction
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Wizard ADX pattern tests (continuation of prior ADX article); used with ATR module in same piece
why_new_for_mis: Uses the drop of trend-strength from elevated (>50) to moderated (≤40) as an explicit regime-change / trend-exhaustion sensor rather than only ADX>25 as ‘trend on’.
quote: a drop in the readings of the main oscillator buffer from above the 50 level to below 4 over about 2 – 3 price bars… the current trend is weakening and therefore a reversal

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: Ichimoku Kumo S/R events gated by ADX and ±DI
mechanism: Ten patterns: price cross Senkou A with ADX≥25; Tenkan/Kijun cross ADX≥20; Senkou A/B cloud flip ADX≥25; bounce/reject at Span A with ±DI alignment ADX≥25; Chikou vs Span A ADX≥25; bounce at Tenkan with DI; price cross Kijun with DI; bounce at Span B inside cloud ADX≥20 rising; price above/below cloud ADX≥25; Chikou vs cloud ADX≥25. Kumo thickness noted as trend-strength visual.
data_needed: Ichimoku buffers (9/26/52) with Chikou read shifted +26; ADX Wilder main/+DI/−DI
why_new_for_mis: Fuses cloud geometry (break, flip, bounce, above/below) with a numeric trend-strength gate—MIS can treat Kumo state × ADX level as a joint support/resistance and trend-regime feature set.
quote: The bullish signal for pattern-0 is when price crosses above the Senkou span A, marking a breakout above the Kumo cloud. This should typically be backed by a solid ADX reading of at least 25.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: Gator histograms from |Jaw−Teeth| (up) and −|Teeth−Lips| (down) with green/red expansion colours encode Alligator phases. Pattern0: awakening (one green/one red) + price breakout + rising/falling AD. Pattern1: eating (both green) + sustained AD trend with price. Pattern2: fill-out then both-green resume with AD holding. Pattern3: both-red weakening + price vs AD divergence. Pattern4: sated colour flip + AD flatten/turn for exhaustion exit/reversal. AD = fast−slow EMA of ADL from tick-volume money-flow (fib 5/13).
data_needed: Gator (Alligator SMMA 13/8/5 with shifts 8/5/3); AD oscillator on tick volume; price highs/lows for direction
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPJPY M30; train 2023, forward 2024; patterns 0–4 in this part (5–9 deferred)
why_new_for_mis: Maps Bill-Williams mouth phases to a discrete momentum/vol regime label and couples it with a signed volume-flow oscillator—MIS gets a phase×liquidity confirmation sensor, including divergence and exhaustion.
quote: these four phases map points on a cycle that includes trending markets and flat/choppy situations. They are particularly instrumental in spotting the start of a trend aka the jaws opening or its exhaustion
